title: Structure-preserving uncertainty quantification for GENERIC dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.12624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structure-preserving machine learning embeds physical structure directly into model architectures, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such hard-constrained models remains limited because standard UQ methods may violate the encoded admissibility conditions, require architectural modifications, or impose substantial computational costs. In this work, we propose Structure-Preserving Epistemic Neural Networks (S-PENNs), a general framework for UQ in scientific machine learning models with hard architectural constraints, and instantiate it for GENERIC (General Equation for Non-Equilibrium Reversible-Irreversible Coupling) dynamics. S-PENNs preserve the structural constraints of a pretrained model by attaching lightweight epinets to its constrained components, ensuring that every sampled realization remains physically admissible by construction. translated_title: 保持结构的GENERIC动力学不确定性量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12624v1 公告类型：新 摘要：结构保持机器学习将物理结构直接嵌入模型架构中，然而对于这类硬约束模型的不确定性量化（UQ）仍然有限，因为标准UQ方法可能违反编码的可接受性条件，需要架构修改，或带来大量计算成本。在本工作中，我们提出了结构保持认知神经网络（S-PENNs），这是一个用于具有硬架构约束的科学机器学习模型中UQ的通用框架，并将其应用于GENERIC（非平衡可逆-不可逆耦合的一般方程）动力学。S-PENNs通过将轻量级认知网络附加到预训练模型的约束组件上，保留其结构约束，确保每个采样实现通过构造在物理上可接受。当应用于GENERIC动力学时，所提出的框架产生热力学一致的结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了S-PENNs框架，通过轻量级认知网络保持GENERIC动力学的硬约束结构，实现物理上可接受的不确定性量化，并确保热力学一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the S-PENNs framework, which preserves hard structural constraints in GENERIC dynamics via lightweight epinets, enabling physically admissible uncertainty quantification with thermodynamic consistency.
